content: {"reasoning":"The authorization was required, the retro-authorization window is closed, no peer-to-peer is offered, and the prior medical-necessity appeal did not overturn CO-197. Because CO-197 is a contractual-obligation denial rather than an assigned deductible amount, the balance is not properly billable to the patient despite the remaining deductible, leaving no collectible payer or patient liability.","action":"write_off"}
